confirm.description:
Assist pipeline saves the audio of every voice command because `debug_recording_dir` is set in your configuration. {count} recordings ({size} MB) are kept in `{path}`, and they are never deleted automatically.

Select **Submit** to delete them. To stop recording, remove `debug_recording_dir` from your configuration and restart Home Assistant.
